settings.purpose: the platform's origin on the environment the audit runs in (dev), with no path; the agent, the deploy queue's records and the package are read there, and the report is filed there. Without it nothing can be audited
prod's origin, with no path, read for the version prod runs. Without it the agent is read on one environment and the report says so

the path to the package maker's build.py on a host that has it and python3, so its own format and standing-asset rules run over the package. Without it those checks read the rules from the signed build record or the Descriptor, as the report says

directories.name: records
directories.purpose: one folder per job, holding the findings and what the ledger said, where the report was filed, and what the job went without
